visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with braids, wearing a yellow plaid shirt over a white top, stands on a sunny urban sidewalk gesturing enthusiastically at the camera. A quick cut shows a refrigerator display shelf filled with colorful side dishes like broccoli and carrots. (2) The woman stands outside 'Daren Noodle House' with arms spread wide in a welcoming gesture. Inside, the camera focuses on a wall decorated with green artificial grass and several framed award certificates from Taipei city government. (3) Close-up shots show a steaming white bowl of beef soup placed on a bed of black stones. The woman sits at a table inside the brightly lit restaurant, using chopsticks to lift large pieces of beef and tendon, showing steam rising from the hot dish. (4) Outside '21 Chicken Soup Noodles', the woman gestures towards the storefront. Inside, she is seen eating a bowl of noodles with chicken and vegetables, followed by shots of various side dishes like pork chops and sliced ears. She points to a poster of Olympic boxer Wu Shih-yi. (5) The woman enters 'Rizi Hen Tian' dessert shop and is seen eating a large bowl of snowflake ice topped with pearls and a biscuit. Close-up shots highlight the texture of the shaved ice and a bowl of tofu pudding topped with peanuts and taro balls. (6) The woman walks into 'Gao Fei Shelter Workshop'. The interior is a clean, well-lit dining area. She eats a grilled chicken leg meal and later a slice of mango roll cake. Shots of staff in uniforms and masks preparing food are shown. (7) The woman points out 'Friendly' stickers on a glass door, including LGBT and accessibility icons. She is seen washing her hands in a clean bathroom and pointing to a shelf containing feminine hygiene products. (8) The woman pays at a counter using her smartphone. The video concludes with a graphic containing a QR code for 'Taipei Friendly Stories'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy female speech at a rapid rate. Upbeat acoustic pop music with a steady rhythmic drum beat and guitar strumming starts immediately. (2) A subtle 'pop' sound effect occurs as graphic titles appear on screen. The vocal tone is extremely friendly and excited, maintaining high pitch variability throughout. (3) The background music remains consistent in tempo and volume as the narrator transitions between describing different restaurants. No significant ambient noise from the restaurants is audible, suggesting a clean post-produced voiceover. (4) The speech density remains high, with very short pauses between sentences to keep the pace brisk. (5) As the focus shifts to the 'friendly' features, the narrator's tone becomes slightly more informative but retains its high arousal level. (6) The video concludes with the music fading out as the final call to action is spoken.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of Shop 1 -> Shop 2 -> Shop 3 -> Shop 4 -> Thematic Synthesis (Friendly Services) -> CTA -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Taipei Friendly Shops' initiative by showcasing four specific restaurants in the Neihu district that not only offer high-quality food but also provide inclusive services such as accessibility, gender-neutral restrooms, and multilingual support.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of four specific restaurant brands, their signature dishes, prices, and specific 'Friendly' labels provided by the city government, concluding with a QR code invitation to participate in a related activity.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality social media production with fast cuts and dense subtitles, effectively merging food blogging with social advocacy for urban inclusivity.
